import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { ReactFlow, Handle, Position, MarkerType } from "@xyflow/react";

const nodes = [
  {
    id: "request",
    x: 7,
    y: 35,
    title: "Request a visual",
    sub: "Primary Pi session",
    detail:
      "widgets.present supplies a brief, optional data and Markdown fallback. Generated source is delegated, not authored by this operation.",
    source: "src/services/pi/runtime/cake-artifact-operations.ts · widgets.present (283–345)",
  },
  {
    id: "specialist",
    x: 55,
    y: 35,
    title: "Specialist",
    sub: "Pi · no tools",
    detail:
      "An isolated Pi session returns one cake-react result. Generation and repair disable tools and project trust; the restricted loader excludes extensions and context files.",
    source:
      "src/services/pi/runtime/sidecar-runtime.ts · runInlineWidgetGeneration / runInlineWidgetRepair; isolated-session-runner.ts · runIsolatedSession",
  },
  {
    id: "repair",
    x: 7,
    y: 111,
    title: "One repair",
    sub: "Same restrictions",
    detail:
      "On compile failure, source, diagnostic and brief context go to a restricted repair session. Its result is compiled again. A second failure propagates; this is not an unbounded retry loop.",
    source: "src/services/pi/ProjectSessionIntegrationHost.ts · generateInlineWidget (217–253)",
  },
  {
    id: "compile",
    x: 55,
    y: 111,
    title: "Compile gate",
    sub: "Import allowlist",
    detail:
      "Extraction and compilation precede persistence. The compiler caps source at 1 MiB and restricts imports. Compile success is not proof of visual quality or runtime correctness.",
    source:
      "src/services/widgets/inline-widget-service.ts · compileInlineWidget / widgetModulePlugin",
  },
  {
    id: "pointer",
    x: 7,
    y: 186,
    title: "Pi pointer",
    sub: "Pi owns history",
    detail:
      "After persistence succeeds, the operation appends a Pi custom entry pointing to the artifact record. The transcript pointer is not another copy of the widget payload.",
    source:
      "src/services/pi/runtime/cake-artifact-operations.ts · appendPointer (90–104), widgets.present (330–345)",
  },
  {
    id: "repository",
    x: 55,
    y: 186,
    title: "Artifact record",
    sub: "Cake owns payload",
    detail:
      "The repository validates input, writes content-addressed immutable payload blobs and owns revision metadata. The integration host emits artifact-updated after upsert.",
    source:
      "src/services/storage/ArtifactStorageLive.ts · ArtifactRepository.upsert; src/services/pi/ProjectSessionIntegrationHost.ts · persistArtifact (195–215)",
  },
  {

    x: 55,
    y: 267,
    title: "Artifact viewer",
    sub: "Renderer projection",

      "WidgetArtifact asks InlineWidgetStore to compile the stored source for display. It embeds the resulting cake-widget document and validates tokenized messages. This display compile is separate from the pre-publication gate.",
    source:
      "src/renderer/components/widget-artifact.tsx · WidgetArtifact; src/renderer/stores/InlineWidgetStore.ts",
  },
  {
    id: "widget",
    x: 55,
    y: 346,
    title: "Interactive widget",
    sub: "Opaque-origin iframe",
    detail:
      "The allow-scripts iframe runs generated React without Cake, Node or parent-DOM privileges. CSP blocks arbitrary network/API access, with explicit data/HTTPS media allowances. Selection here is local presentation state only.",
    source:

const edges = [
  {
    id: "brief",
    source: "request",
    target: "specialist",
    sourceHandle: "right",
    targetHandle: "left",
    label: "brief",
  },
  { id: "source", source: "specialist", target: "compile", label: "React source" },
  {
    id: "diagnostic",
    source: "compile",
    target: "repair",
    sourceHandle: "left",
    targetHandle: "right",
    label: "failure",
  },
  {
    id: "retry",
    source: "repair",
    target: "compile",
    sourceHandle: "bottom",
    targetHandle: "retry",
    label: "retry once",
    type: "smoothstep",
  },
  { id: "publish", source: "compile", target: "repository", label: "pass only" },
  {
    id: "pointer",
    source: "repository",
    target: "pointer",
    sourceHandle: "left",
    targetHandle: "right",
    label: "pointer",
  },
  { id: "display", source: "repository", target: "viewer", label: "stored source" },
  { id: "embed", source: "viewer", target: "widget", label: "compile & embed" },
];
function DiagramNode({ data }) {
  return (
    <div className="graph-node">
      <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} id="top" />
      <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} id="bottom" />
      <Handle type="target" position={Position.Left} id="left" />
      <Handle type="source" position={Position.Left} id="left" />
      <Handle type="target" position={Position.Right} id="right" />
      <Handle type="source" position={Position.Right} id="right" />
      <Handle type="target" position={Position.Left} id="retry" style={{ top: "78%" }} />
      <strong>{data.title}</strong>
      <small>{data.sub}</small>
    </div>
  );
}
const nodeTypes = { explanation: DiagramNode };
const paths = {
  publish: ["brief", "source", "publish", "pointer", "display", "embed"],
  repair: ["diagnostic", "retry", "publish"],
  isolation: ["source", "diagnostic", "retry", "embed"],
};
export default function WidgetPipeline() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState("compile");
  const [path, setPath] = useState("publish");
  const [evidence, setEvidence] = useState(false);
  const [wide, setWide] = useState(window.innerWidth >= 1100);
  useEffect(() => {
    const resize = () => setWide(window.innerWidth >= 1100);
    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", resize);
  }, []);
  const node = nodes.find((n) => n.id === selected);
  const active = (e) =>
    path === "neighbors"
      ? e.source === selected || e.target === selected
      : paths[path].includes(e.id);
  return (
    <main className="explanation">
      <style>{`
      *{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#f6f7f4;color:#1d302d;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif} .explanation{--paper:#fff;--line:#859891;--muted:#546b63;--accent:#006952;--wash:#e8f2eb; padding:14px;max-width:1220px;margin:auto} h1{font-size:23px;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.8px;margin:6px 0 10px} .eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.8px;font-weight:750;color:var(--accent)} .intro{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted)} .controls{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0} button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer} .controls button,.evidence{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 6px;font-size:10px} button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper);border-color:var(--accent)} button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #da8700;outline-offset:3px} .map{position:relative;height:400px;min-width:302px} .boundary{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--paper)} .main{top:0;height:246px}.main small{display:none}.renderer{top:254px;height:72px}.sandbox{top:334px;height:66px;border-style:dashed;background:var(--wash)} .boundary-label{position:absolute;left:12px;top:10px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);max-width:95%} .renderer .boundary-label,.sandbox .boundary-label{top:18px;max-width:45%;line-height:1.8} .boundary small{display:block;letter-spacing:0;font-size:11px;font-weight:400} .react-flow__node{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--paper);color:inherit;height:48px}.react-flow__node.selected{border:2px solid var(--accent);background:var(--wash)}.graph-node{padding:6px 7px}.graph-node strong{display:block;font-size:11px;line-height:18px;white-space:nowrap}.graph-node small{display:block;font-size:10px;line-height:14px;white-space:nowrap}.react-flow__handle{width:4px;height:4px;min-width:4px;min-height:4px;border:0;background:var(--line)}.react-flow__node:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #da8700;outline-offset:3px}.react-flow__edge-text{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif} .detail{padding:15px 0 0}.detail .eyebrow{font-size:10px} h2{font-size:19px;margin:5px 0 8px}.detail p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 12px}.evidence{font-weight:600}.source{margin-top:12px;font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding:12px;background:var(--wash);border-radius:6px}.caveat{font-size:11px!important;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px!important}.legend{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 0} @media(min-width:1100px){.explanation{padding:36px}h1{font-size:38px}.intro{font-size:15px;max-width:720px}.composition{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(590px,1.6fr) minmax(260px,1fr);gap:36px}.detail{padding-top:34px} .graph-node strong{font-size:15px}.graph-node small{font-size:11px}.edge-label{font-size:11px}.boundary-label{font-size:11px} .detail p{font-size:15px}h2{font-size:23px}} @media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){body{background:#101c1b;color:#e5ede8}.explanation{--paper:#182826;--line:#82968e;--muted:#a7bbb2;--accent:#8ce0bd;--wash:#233f35} .controls button[aria-pressed=true]{color:#10251d}.node[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--accent)}} @media(max-width:390px){.explanation{padding:12px}.node{padding-left:6px}.node strong{font-size:11px}.edge-label{font-size:9px}}
    `}</style>
      <div className="eyebrow">CAKE / DELEGATED WIDGET PATH</div>
      <h1>One gate. Two outcomes.</h1>
      <p className="intro">
        Source can pass to publication or take one repair loop. Neither route grants the generated
        widget host privileges.
      </p>
      <nav className="controls" aria-label="Highlight a path">
        {[
          ["publish", "Publication"],
          ["repair", "Repair loop"],
          ["isolation", "Isolation"],
          ["neighbors", "Neighbors"],
        ].map(([id, label]) => (
          <button
            key={id}
            aria-pressed={path === id}
            onClick={() => {
              setPath(id);
              if (id === "repair") setSelected("repair");
              if (id === "isolation") setSelected("widget");
            }}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <div className="composition">
        <section aria-label="Widget dependency diagram">
          <div className="map">
            <div className="boundary main">
              <div className="boundary-label">
                ELECTRON MAIN <small>Pi execution · Cake storage</small>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="boundary renderer">
              <div className="boundary-label">
                RENDERER<small>Derived display · not storage</small>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="boundary sandbox">
              <div className="boundary-label">
                GENERATED CODE<small>allow-scripts · no same-origin</small>
              </div>
            </div>
            <ReactFlow
              key={wide ? "wide" : "compact"}
              nodes={nodes.map((n) => ({
                id: n.id,
                type: "explanation",
                position: { x: n.x === 7 ? (wide ? 30 : 12) : wide ? 350 : 178, y: n.y },
                data: n,
                selected: n.id === selected,
                style: { width: wide ? 210 : 116 },
                ariaLabel: n.title,
              }))}
              edges={edges.map((e) => ({
                ...e,
                sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle || "bottom",
                targetHandle: e.targetHandle || "top",
                type: e.type || "straight",
                className: active(e) ? "highlighted" : "muted",
                markerEnd: {
                  type: MarkerType.ArrowClosed,
                  width: 18,
                  height: 18,
                  color: active(e) ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--line)",
                },
                style: {
                  stroke: active(e) ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--line)",
                  strokeWidth: active(e) ? 2 : 1.3,
                  opacity: active(e) ? 1 : 0.35,
                },
                labelStyle: { fill: "var(--muted)", fontSize: 10 },
                labelBgStyle: { fill: "var(--paper)" },
                labelBgPadding: [3, 2],
                pathOptions: { offset: 12 },
              }))}
              nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
              onNodeClick={(_, n) => setSelected(n.id)}
              onSelectionChange={({ nodes: selectedNodes }) => {
                if (selectedNodes.length === 1) setSelected(selectedNodes[0].id);
              }}
              nodesDraggable={false}
              nodesConnectable={false}
              edgesFocusable={false}
              panOnDrag={false}
              zoomOnScroll={false}
              zoomOnPinch={false}
              zoomOnDoubleClick={false}
              minZoom={1}
              maxZoom={1}
              defaultViewport={{ x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 }}
              proOptions={{ hideAttribution: true }}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="legend">
            Arrows show directed handoffs, not elapsed time. Select any node.
          </p>
        </section>
        <aside className="detail" aria-live="polite">
          <div className="eyebrow">
            SELECTED /{" "}
            {path === "neighbors"
              ? "DIRECT CONNECTIONS"
              : path === "repair"
                ? "REPAIR PATH"
                : path === "isolation"
                  ? "RESTRICTIONS"
                  : "PUBLICATION PATH"}
          </div>
          <h2>{node.title}</h2>
          <p>{node.detail}</p>
          <button
            className="evidence"
            aria-expanded={evidence}
            onClick={() => setEvidence(!evidence)}
          >
            Source evidence
          </button>
          {evidence && <div className="source">{node.source}</div>}
          <p className="caveat">
            Source-backed interpretation of the existing widgets.present path, not a live trace or
            the proposed explanation generator. Failed-revision retention is not demonstrated here.
          </p>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
